media.alt: K&A Performance slide on a cream background: 2 of 3 spots left. Free social media management for 3 months. Three reserved-seat tickets numbered 1, 2 and 3: spot 1 is grayed out and stamped filled, spots 2 and 3 are marked open. For businesses in Gainesville and Alachua County. Facebook and Instagram, planned, made and posted for you. Swipe for what you get.

A ticket labeled Included, 2 of 3 spots left. What you get, free for 3 months: 3 posts a week on Facebook and Instagram, 2 reels or carousels plus 1 tip or carousel. A monthly content plan you approve once, before anything is made. A short monthly results report: reach, engagement, and clicks to your site. Captions, music and scheduling, all handled for you. The ticket stub reads admit one business, Gainesville and Alachua County, with spot 1 filled and spots 2 and 3 open.

A ticket labeled Your part, 2 of 3 spots left. What we ask in return: approve each month's plan within 2 business days. Add us as a manager in Meta so we can post. Send real photos or footage when we ask. Let us share your results as a case study, and a short review if you are happy. An honest check-in at the end of month 3. The stub shows spot 1 filled, spots 2 and 3 open.

A ticket labeled After 3 months. Then you decide. $600 a month, month to month. Pilot businesses keep $600 locked for as long as they stay. No auto-billing, no contract, cancel any time. You continue only if it is paying off.

A ticket labeled The fine print. What it is not: no paid ads, ad spend is not included. No promised numbers, we do not promise followers or sales. Your inbox stays yours, you keep replying to comments and DMs.

A dark teal ticket labeled How to claim, 2 of 3 spots left. Claim one of the last 2 spots. Call Alex, 904-210-1071, or message K&A Performance on Facebook or Instagram. Alex picks the best fits. No contract. No card. The stub shows spot 1 filled, spots 2 and 3 open. K&A Performance logo and ka-performancefl.com at the top.
